laws.title: Theft
laws.description: Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to take it.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

laws.title: Punishment for Theft
laws.description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

laws.title: Extortion
laws.description: Whoever intentionally puts any person in fear of any injury and thereby dishonestly induces that person to deliver any property.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

laws.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
laws.description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces any person to deliver any property or to make any valuable security.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

laws.title: Criminal breach of trust
laws.description: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

laws.title: Punishment for assault or criminal force
laws.description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any person.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to ₹500, or both.

laws.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
laws.description: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt to any person.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both.

laws.title: Punishment for murder
laws.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life.
laws.punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine.

laws.title: Attempt to murder
laws.description: Whoever does any act with intention or knowledge that it may cause death.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.

laws.title: Punishment for rape
laws.description: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment.
laws.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 10 years, may extend to life.

laws.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
laws.description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman with intent to outrage her modesty.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

laws.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
laws.description: Whoever intends to insult the modesty of a woman by word, gesture or act.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

laws.title: Dowry death
laws.description: Where the death of a woman is caused by burns or bodily injury within 7 years of marriage.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment not less than 7 years, may extend to life.

laws.title: Husband or relative subjecting woman to cruelty
laws.description: Whoever subjects a woman to cruelty by husband or his relatives.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

laws.title: IT Act Section 66 - Computer related offences
laws.description: Hacking, identity theft, data theft, sending offensive messages, etc.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and/or fine up to ₹5 lakh.

laws.title: IT Act Section 67 - Publishing obscene material
laws.description: Publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form.
laws.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.
